review_candidates.title: Network Administrator
review_candidates.description: Be the one who makes a difference! At Vertex Education we are a team of high achievers, courageous leaders, and passionate believers in changing lives through education. As a purpose-led education services provider, our mission is destined to benefit many and yet it starts with just one person inspired to work together with us to make a memorable and meaningful difference for our clients, schools, students, and communities. Be the one who makes a difference—with us. 1. Network Management & Optimization: Deploy, configure, and maintain wired and wireless networks across multiple school sites. Manage and optimize enterprise-grade Wi-Fi solutions (e.g., Juniper Mist, Ubiquiti). Configure and troubleshoot VLANs, VPNs, firewalls, and content filtering solutions. Implement bandwidth management and traffic shaping best practices. 2. Security & Compliance: Implement and maintain compliance with CIPA and FERPA regulations. Deploy and manage firewall rules, IDS/IPS systems, and web content filtering. Support cybersecurity initiatives, including zero-trust and endpoint protection. Monitor and respond to network security incidents. 3. Monitoring & Troubleshootin: Continuously monitor network health using tools like Auvik and Panorama. Resolve issues such as Wi-Fi disruptions and bandwidth congestion. Collaborate with helpdesk on escalated network tickets. Implement proactive measures to minimize classroom network downtime. 4. Cloud & Hybrid Network Solutions: Manage cloud-based networking in Azure, AWS, and Google Workspace. Support VoIP and video conferencing platforms like Zoom and Google Meet. Integrate classroom technologies (LMS, student devices, interactive tools). Align hybrid network solutions with evolving educational needs. 5. Client Support & Documentation: Provide on-site and remote network support to school teams. Maintain detailed documentation of network configurations and recovery plans. Train school IT personnel on security, troubleshooting, and best practices. Collaborate with school leadership and IT to align networks with academic goals. Required Qualifications: Education & Experience: Associate’s or Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 3+ years of network administration experience, preferably in education or MSP environments. Technical Expertise: Knowledge of TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VLANs, OSPF, BGP protocols. Experience with Cisco, Meraki, Fortinet, Palo Alto, or Ubiquiti networks. Proficiency in high-density Wi-Fi (802.11ax, roaming, controller-based Wi-Fi). Familiarity with firewalls, content filtering, and K-12 cybersecurity best practices. Experience with Windows Server, Active Directory, Google Workspace, and Office 365. Preferred Qualifications: Certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Fortinet NSE, or Meraki CMNA. Experience managing 1:1 student device deployments (e.g., Chromebooks, iPads). Knowledge of E-rate funding and network infrastructure grants. Understanding of K-12 cybersecurity risks and compliance needs. Experience with Google Admin Console and Microsoft Intune. Be excited to be a part of our team and grow your career with us! Be the one who enables us to positively impact over 258,000 students across multiple states while driving our growth forward so we can enrich even more lives. Be the one who helps us achieve excellence for over 226 schools that we support with academics, finance, technology, human resources, communications, marketing, facilities, construction, and food services. Be the one who is a diverse thinker, a team player, a smart risk taker, an innovator, and a difference maker by encouraging others to climb higher and reach farther to further education. Be yourself surrounded by wonderful people who care about you, value your unique skills, and lift you up. Be supported in your work by caring leaders and team members who want you to succeed. Be empowered to make a difference and climb higher and reach farther to change lives through education. Be well in all aspects of your life from your physical, mental, and emotional wellbeing to your finances. Enjoy industry-leading pay, rewards, referral bonuses, with unlimited flexible paid time-off for performance. Be able to care for your health and your family with comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits and invest in your future with 401(k) plans with a 6% employer match on your contributions. Enhance your growth and development with mentoring and money to take training classes. Thrive in a welcoming, supportive, and inclusive environment where we treat others with fairness and respect, celebrate diversity, and elevate equality and inclusion as an equal opportunity employer. Be the one who makes a difference! With an innovative mind, a hungry heart, and engaging spirit you can change lives through education. Be a part of Vertex Education and let’s make a difference together. Apply Today!

review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: Copart, Inc. a technology leader and the premier online vehicle auction platform globally, with over 200 facilities located across the world, Copart links vehicle sellers to more than 750,000 buyers in over 190 countries. We believe in providing an unmatched experience, every day and everywhere, driven by our people, processes, and technology. Copart is seeking a Senior Network Engineer based out of Las Vegas . In this role, you will help design, build, operate, and continuously improve Copart's global network infrastructure, supporting enterprise data centers, remote offices, and critical business services worldwide. As a senior member of the team, you will lead technical initiatives, influence engineering decisions, mentor fellow engineers, and drive operational excellence across our global network. Ideal Candidate Ownership – Takes ownership of the health of the environment, not just assigned tasks. Proactively identifies issues, follows through on commitments, and consistently looks for opportunities to improve systems, processes, and documentation. Believes in leaving the environment better than they found it. Engineering Mindset – Solves problems by understanding the "why," balancing technical excellence with operational practicality, and making decisions supported by data. Continuous Improvement – Constantly looks for opportunities to improve systems, processes, automation, and documentation, leaving things better than they found them. Collaborative – Shares knowledge, mentors others, communicates effectively, and recognizes that the best engineering outcomes come from strong teamwork. Curious – Continually expands technical knowledge beyond networking, embracing automation, AI-assisted engineering, and emerging technologies to solve increasingly complex problems. “ We hire engineers for their mindset, not just their résumé. Experience matters, but we place even greater value on ownership, technical judgment, curiosity, continuous improvement, and the ability to positively influence those around you.” Essential Duties And Responsibilities Own network projects from initial planning through implementation, validation, documentation, and operational handoff. Lead the technical design, optimization, and deployment of enterprise network infrastructure across global data centers and remote sites. Develop well-supported technical proposals by analyzing operational data, business requirements, performance metrics, and long-term scalability. Present recommendations with clear trade-offs, risks, and implementation strategies. Provide technical leadership on cross-functional initiatives, driving engineering decisions through collaboration, sound technical judgment, and data-driven analysis. Review engineering designs, implementation plans, and change requests to ensure alignment with network standards and operational best practices. Serve as a technical mentor to junior engineers by providing guidance, sharing knowledge, and promoting engineering excellence and accountability. Plan and lead network implementations, upgrades, migrations, and maintenance activities with minimal business impact. Deploy, scale, and continuously improve enterprise networking solutions across global offices and data centers. Support and optimize a global WAN environment consisting of Fortinet SD-WAN, Site-to-Site VPN, and point-to-point connectivity. Analyze application behavior, network performance, and capacity trends to recommend infrastructure improvements. Research, evaluate, and recommend technologies that improve network reliability, visibility, operational efficiency, and automation. Develop, maintain, and enforce network standards, engineering best practices, and operational procedures. Create and maintain technical documentation, network diagrams, troubleshooting guides, and standard operating procedures. Proactively monitor network health and resolve issues before they impact production services. Lead troubleshooting efforts during complex infrastructure and application incidents, driving root cause analysis and permanent corrective actions. Review, implement, and validate network changes in accordance with established Change Management (ITIL) processes. Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to understand business requirements and deliver scalable, reliable network solutions. Act as a backup engineer on peer-owned projects to ensure continuity, knowledge sharing, and successful project delivery. Participate in an on-call rotation supporting production infrastructure. Demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills while thriving in a collaborative engineering environment. Experience with network automation, AI-assisted operations, or agentic workflows is highly desirable. Provide periodic "smart hands" and physical support (e.g., server hardware swaps, cabling, component replacement) in collaboration with remote engineering and IT teams. Technical Qualifications Enterprise Networking Extensive experience designing, implementing, and troubleshooting enterprise network (L2/L3) infrastructure using Cisco enterprise platforms (Catalyst, Nexus). Experience implementing and supporting enterprise security in ANY of platforms (Fortinet, Cisco Firepower/ASA, Palo Alto, or equivalent). Core Technical Skills Enterprise routing and switching (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, VRF, VLANs, STP) Layer 2 technologies (LACP/EtherChannel, VPC, Switch Stacking) Enterprise security (ACLs, NAT, VPNs, TACACS+, Cisco ISE or equivalent) High availability and resilient network design Enterprise data center networking Preferred Expectations Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills Experience leading technical projects or mentoring engineers Excellent communication and collaboration skills Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment Flexible to participate in on-call rotations and occasional off-hours work Preferred Qualifications (Experience In Any Of The Following) Linux/Unix Python, Ansible, APIs, or network automation AI-assisted engineering and agentic workflows Enterprise monitoring, observability, or configuration management tools A10 load balancers or comparable technologies Experience & Certifications CCNP/CCIE or equivalent experience is highly desirable. 7+ years of working experience in the Networking Engineering Field. (While 7+ years of networking experience is generally expected for this role, we place greater value on engineering mindset, ownership, technical curiosity, sound judgment, and the ability to make meaningful contributions than on years of experience alone.) Benefits Summary Medical/Dental/Vision 401k plus a company match ESPP - Employee Stock Purchase Plan EAP - Employee Assistance Program (no cost to you) Vacation & Sick pay Paid Company Holidays Life and AD&D Insurance Discounts Along With Many Other Employee Benefits. At Copart, we are focused on harnessing the power of diversity, inclusion, and collaboration. By embracing diverse perspectives, we open doors to innovation and unleash the full potential of our team. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels appreciated, included, and inspired to grow and contribute meaningfully. E-Verify Program Participant: Copart participates in the Department of Homeland Security U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services' E-Verify program (For U.S. applicants and employees only). review_candidates.description: Lyntris is a defense technology company that connects sensing to action across the connected battlespace. Combining differentiated hardware, software and mission expertise, Lyntris helps customers sense threats, make sense of complex conditions and act with greater speed, precision and confidence in contested environments. Lyntris supports U.S. and allied defense organizations across every branch — including Navy, Army, Air Force, Space Force and allied partners — spanning strategic, operational and tactical missions and every domain: Space, Air, Land, Sea and Cyber. With more than 200 active defense programs, Lyntris works at every level of the mission, from national command authority to the tactical edge. Solutions are designed by operators who understand the mission, engineered for the conditions that degrade or defeat standard systems, and built on an open, modular architecture that integrates into existing programs without requiring them to start over. Lyntris moves faster than the traditional defense cycle — with integrated design, build and test capabilities in-house — and delivers systems that sustain and endure long after initial fielding. We are seeking a Senior Network Engineer to strengthen networking initiatives supporting Foreign Military Sales (FMS) programs. The ideal candidate will have substantial experience with military C4I systems and secure operational networks. Design and implementation of complex solutions Investigate and recommend security products with a focus on integration of management and monitoring platforms. Advance knowledge with TCP/IP, MPLS, OSPF, EIGRP, DMVPN/mGRE. review_candidates.description: Summary The IBM i (AS/400) Systems Administrator is responsible for the stability, security, performance, and continuity of the IBM i platform hosting our customized, mission-critical RPG-based ERP/WMS ecosystem. This role ensures high availability of core business processes, manages reliable Disaster Recovery (DR) replication using Maxava, and oversees our hybrid infrastructure spanning on-premises IBM Power Systems and IBM PowerVS Cloud environments. Essential Duties And Responsibilities Platform Administration & Operations: Administer IBM i environments (LPARs, HMC, hardware/storage). Manage the OS/PTF lifecycle, monitor subsystems, batch operations, advanced job scheduling, and system housekeeping. High Availability & Disaster Recovery: Own the DR strategy end-to-end. Operate and tune Maxava replication, manage the IBM PowerVS Cloud DR environment, and execute regular, validated failover testing. Backup & Recovery: Architect and maintain the backup strategy utilizing BRMS, ensuring data integrity and successful restore testing. ERP/WMS Support: Provide infrastructure-level support for the RPG-based ERP/WMS. Coordinate application deployments, change management, and troubleshoot across application, database, and OS layers. Performance & Capacity Management: Tune CPU, memory, and disk I/O. Optimize batch jobs and Db2 for i database performance using modern IBM i SQL services. Security & Compliance: Manage user profiles, object authority, system values, audit logging (QAUDJRN), and ensure compliance with security frameworks. Integration & Automation: Maintain network connectivity, secure protocols (SFTP, APIs), and EDI integration flows. Automate routine administration tasks using CL and QShell/bash. Documentation: Maintain rigorous SOPs, runbooks, and configuration management (CMDB). Nice-to-Have Experience migrating on-premises IBM i workloads to PowerVS Cloud. Exposure to modern DevOps/automation tools on IBM i. Formal IBM Certifications (e.g., IBM Certified System Administrator - IBM i). Experience supporting major IBM i ERPs or WMS platforms. Success Profile Own DR end-to-end Strong Maxava and journaling expertise Experience with ERP/WMS systems Hybrid on-prem and cloud environment knowledge Strong security and audit discipline Qualifications MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS: Education & Experience 5+ years administering IBM i (AS/400, iSeries, System i) in 24/7 production environments. Demonstrated success with OS/PTF upgrades, HA/DR, BRMS, and performance tuning. Prior experience migrating or operating on new-generation Power Systems (Power9/Power10/Power11). Core Technical Skills IBM i Administration: LPAR/HMC/VIOS, device/IFS management, system values, service tools. Backup & Recovery: BRMS, SAV/RST strategies, encryption, restore drills, and media/VTL governance. HA/DR: PowerHA for i, MIMIX/iTera (or equivalent), replication design, DR runbooks/testing. Security: QAUDJRN, object authorities, exit points, TLS/SSL and certificate lifecycle (DCM), vulnerability patching. Automation: CL, QShell, PASE; familiarity with Python/Rexx for ops scripting. Database (Db2 for i): SQL tuning, indexes/access paths, journaling, commitment control, reorgs, Visual Explain. Scheduling & Monitoring: IBM i scheduler or enterprise tools (Robot, Control M), Collection Services/Navigator/ACS, and third party performance tools. Networking: TCP/IP stack, DNS/routing, ACS/ODBC, SFTP/FTPS/SSH; exposure to MQ is a plus. Preferred Skills: Hands-on with Power11 capacity planning, shared processor pools, and dynamic LPAR moves. Firmware/HMC/VIOS lifecycle planning aligned to IBM best practices for newest hardware generations. Storage acceleration experience (flash/NVMe), SAN zoning/NPIV, and performance troubleshooting across the I/O stack. PowerHA advanced scenarios (IASP, multi site), Precisely MIMIX tuning and audit, or storage based replication. Security add ons (e.g., Fortra Powertech), SIEM integration, and MFA for IBM i. DevOps awareness: RDi, RPG free format exposure, Git based deployment tooling, TurnOver/ARCAD/X Analysis. Hybrid/Cloud DR patterns (IBM PowerVS), cloud based backup targets, or cross site orchestration. Observability integrations (Robot Monitor/Navigator SQL Services, and hooks to enterprise APM/alerting). ITSM process maturity (ServiceNow/Jira) and CMDB hygiene. Bilingual (EN/FR) communication is an asset. Certifications (Preferred) IBM Certified System Administrator – IBM i (or equivalent experience). HA/DR vendor certifications (Precisely/Rocket). Security: CompTIA Security+, CISSP (plus) or IBM Security specialties. ITIL v4 Foundation. This includes understanding the interoperability between databases and other dependent technology stacks (performance scalability, stability, capacity planning, etc.), possessing familiarity with one dependent technology stack (e.g. windows admin, networking, storage, etc.), working with engineering teams to recommend alternate solutions, and consulting as a 2nd level technical expert on specific platforms. review_candidates.description: POSITION DESCRIPTION: The Lead Cloud Platform / DevSecOps Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure and delivery pipelines in Microsoft Azure, with a primary focus on Azure Government environments. This role is intended to fill a critical gap in Azure platform expertise and will serve as a key resource in establishing and sustaining secure, scalable, and compliant cloud foundations for federal systems. The ideal candidate brings broad, hands-on Azure experience, including Azure Landing Zones, preferably Mission Landing Zone, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and infrastructure deployed in Azure Government with an understanding of IL4/IL5 compliance considerations. This individual will lead the ongoing maintenance and improvement of infrastructure-as-code, cloud configuration, deployment automation, and CI/CD pipelines, while integrating code scanning and automated testing throughout the delivery lifecycle. This role works closely with software engineers, architects, cybersecurity stakeholders, and program leadership to ensure cloud environments are reliable, compliant, and built for operational success in regulated government environments. The successful candidate will combine strong technical depth with sound engineering judgment and the ability to establish repeatable, secure cloud delivery practices across teams. U.S. Citizenship and an active Secret clearance are required. This is a hybrid, full-time position with an onsite requirement of three days per week at our Crystal City headquarters. Key Responsibilities: Azure Cloud Architecture & Platform Engineering  Design, implement, and maintain Azure cloud environments, with strong emphasis on Azure Government. Support and evolve Azure Landing Zone architectures, preferably Mission Landing Zone. Build, configure, and manage Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) environments and supporting Azure services. Ensure cloud environments are secure, scalable, supportable, and aligned with mission and compliance requirements. Infrastructure as Code & Deployment Automation  Develop, maintain, and enhance Infrastructure as Code using Bicep. Manage cloud configuration, environment provisioning, and deployment automation across development, test, and production environments. Standardize infrastructure deployments to improve consistency, security, and maintainability. Support release engineering practices that enable reliable and repeatable application and infrastructure delivery. CI/CD, Security Integration & Quality Engineering  Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines supporting infrastructure and application delivery. Integrate code scanning, dependency scanning, and automated testing into CI/CD workflows. Strengthen DevSecOps practices by embedding security and quality controls throughout the software delivery lifecycle. Improve deployment reliability, traceability, and governance through automation and policy-driven processes. Compliance, Security & Operational Excellence  Engineer and maintain solutions with a compliance-focused mindset appropriate for Azure Government and IL4/IL5 environments. Partner with engineering and security teams to implement secure configurations, logging, monitoring, and access controls. Support audit readiness by ensuring infrastructure, deployments, and pipeline activities are well-documented, reproducible, and aligned with required controls. Contribute to platform hardening, cloud governance, and operational best practices. Collaboration & Technical Leadership  Serve as a subject matter expert in Azure platform engineering and DevSecOps practices. Collaborate with developers, architects, and program leadership to define and implement cloud platform standards. Mentor team members on Azure infrastructure, automation, deployment pipelines, and secure cloud delivery practices. Help drive engineering consistency and maturity across cloud-hosted environments. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE: 7+ years of experience in cloud engineering, platform engineering, DevSecOps, or closely related technical roles. Broad, hands-on experience working across Microsoft Azure services and cloud platform operations. Direct experience with Azure Landing Zones; Mission Landing Zone experience preferred. Strong experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Experience deploying and managing solutions in Azure Government. Understanding of cloud engineering and security requirements associated with IL4/IL5 environments. Strong experience maintaining Infrastructure as Code using Bicep. Experience managing cloud configuration, deployments, and CI/CD pipelines. Experience integrating code scanning and automated testing into CI/CD workflows. Strong understanding of Azure networking fundamentals, including Network Security Groups, route tables, and hub-and-spoke architectures. IAT Level II certification required. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. U.S. Citizenship and active Secret clearance required. DESIRED EXPERIENCE: IAT Level III certification. Experience with Mission Landing Zone implementations. Experience with Azure Log Analytics and cloud observability practices. Experience with Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server. Experience supporting containerized platforms and associated tooling in Azure. Experience managing AWS GovCloud environments. Familiarity with security tooling, policy enforcement, and compliance automation in regulated cloud environments. Experience supporting federal or DoD cloud modernization efforts. WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE OFFER: In addition to competitive salaries and opportunities for professional development and advancement, our employees enjoy a comprehensive range of benefits. To keep pace with the changing needs of our employees, we continually evaluate benefit plans. Paid time off 10 paid holidays Medical insurance Dental insurance Vision insurance Legal assistance Company-paid life insurance and AD&D Company-paid long term and short-term disability insurance Tuition reimbursement 401(k) plan with company contribution Continuing Education Opportunities

review_candidates.description: Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Em Tech Financial Services (Tech FSO) , estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando as necessidades e desafios tecnológicos dos nossos clientes do segmento financeiro, incluindo Mercado de Capitais, Bancos, Fintechs, Seguros e Gestão de Ativos. Entregamos soluções sob medida de acordo com as necessidades específicas de cada negócio, por meio de uma equipe multidisciplinar de especialistas em engenharia, identidade e acessos, segurança da informação, dados, desenvolvimento, UX e análise de negócios. #TechEY #TechFSO Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito? Como Senior SSO Operations Engineer , você atuará em um projeto internacional nearshore para um importante cliente do setor financeiro, prestando suporte operacional e de engenharia às plataformas corporativas de Single Sign-On e Identity and Access Management. Sua atuação estará concentrada na sustentação de ambientes produtivos, no onboarding de aplicações, no gerenciamento de incidentes e solicitações e no troubleshooting de integrações e fluxos de autenticação. Você também contribuirá para a disponibilidade, estabilidade, segurança e performance dos serviços de identidade e acesso. Por que você? Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua: Graduação em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados ou área relacionada; Inglês avançado (B2 ou superior), com capacidade de comunicação em ambiente internacional; Experiência profissional equivalente em tecnologias de identidade e autenticação também poderá ser considerada; Experiência prática em Identity and Access Management, Single Sign-On, federação de identidades e plataformas corporativas de autenticação; Experiência com administração e sustentação de PingFederate ou de outras plataformas enterprise de IAM e SSO; Conhecimento sólido dos protocolos SAML, OAuth 2.0 e OpenID Connect; Conhecimento de conceitos e processos relacionados a autenticação, autorização, federação de identidades e gestão de acessos; Experiência com onboarding de aplicações e manutenção de integrações SSO em ambientes corporativos; Experiência em troubleshooting de falhas de autenticação, autorização, federação e integrações de aplicações; Vivência no suporte a ambientes produtivos e plataformas de autenticação críticas para o negócio; Conhecimento de processos de Incident Management, Incident Response, Request Management e Production Support; Experiência com análise de logs e utilização de ferramentas de monitoramento ou observabilidade; Capacidade para administrar filas de incidentes e solicitações, realizar alterações de configuração e escalar problemas complexos quando necessário; Autonomia, capacidade analítica, organização e facilidade para colaborar com equipes de aplicações, infraestrutura, segurança e engenharia. Serão considerados diferenciais: Experiência prática com PingAccess e PingOne; Experiência com Splunk para análise de logs, monitoramento e investigação de incidentes; Conhecimento de Multi-Factor Authentication e troubleshooting de fluxos de MFA; Experiência com outras plataformas de identidade, como CA SiteMinder, Okta, ForgeRock, Microsoft Entra ID, SailPoint ou CyberArk; Conhecimento de ferramentas e processos de monitoramento da saúde operacional de plataformas; Certificações relacionadas a Ping Identity, IAM, segurança da informação ou tecnologias cloud. Principais responsabilidades: Prestar suporte operacional e de engenharia às plataformas corporativas de Single Sign-On e Identity and Access Management. Administrar, configurar e sustentar ambientes Ping Identity, com foco em PingFederate e, quando aplicável, PingAccess e PingOne. Garantir a estabilidade, disponibilidade, segurança e performance dos serviços de autenticação e controle de acesso. Implementar, manter e atualizar configurações de aplicações integradas ao ambiente SSO. Realizar o onboarding de novas aplicações utilizando padrões e protocolos como SAML, OAuth 2.0 e OpenID Connect. Executar alterações de configuração relacionadas a autenticação, autorização, federação de identidades e políticas de acesso. Investigar e solucionar falhas em fluxos de autenticação, integrações SSO e serviços de Identity and Access Management. Realizar análise de logs utilizando Splunk ou ferramentas equivalentes para diagnosticar incidentes e identificar oportunidades de melhoria. Participar de investigações e respostas a incidentes, contribuindo para a análise de causa raiz e implementação de ações corretivas. Executar health checks e monitorar a disponibilidade, performance e integridade operacional das plataformas de identidade. Administrar filas de solicitações e incidentes, garantindo registro, priorização, acompanhamento, comunicação e resolução adequados. Realizar escalonamentos técnicos e colaborar com engenheiros e especialistas na resolução de problemas de maior complexidade. Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de aplicações, infraestrutura, segurança e operações para garantir serviços confiáveis de autenticação e acesso. Manter procedimentos técnicos, documentação operacional e bases de conhecimento atualizados. Contribuir para iniciativas de automação, padronização e melhoria contínua dos serviços de identidade e gestão de acessos. Conheça alguns de nossos benefícios: Assistência médica e odontológica, Auxílio creche, Plataforma de benefícios e descontos exclusivos EY, Incentivos à educação, Day off de aniversário, Gympass/Wellhub, Participação nos Lucros (PLR), Previdência privada, Vale Alimentação e / ou Vale Alimentação e Transporte, e muito mais. O que oferecemos: Na EY, você se desenvolve com habilidades voltadas para o futuro e se abastece de experiências de classe mundial. Nós capacitaremos você em um ambiente flexível e potencializaremos seus talentos extraordinários em uma cultura diversa e inclusiva, com equipes globalmente conectadas. Pelo 4o ano consecutivo, a EY está na lista do Great Place to Work como uma das melhores empresa para se trabalhar, com destaque para as categorias de diversidade. Você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade. Você gostaria de moldar seu futuro com confiança? Inscreva-se hoje! Para ajudar a criar a melhor experiência durante o processo de recrutamento, por favor, descreva qualquer acessibilidade você possa precisar. Quer se sentir desafiado/a, motivado/a e valorizado/a todos os dias? Inspirar mudanças e deixar um legado? Faça parte do nosso time e ajude-nos na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor! Saiba mais sobre como é trabalhar na EY: Carreiras na EY LinkedIn @EY Instagram @eybrasilcarreiras Oportunidade disponível em modelo presencial (com flexibilidade para o remoto) nos escritórios da EY em todo o Brasil. A EY acredita na igualdade de oportunidades. Independentemente de gênero, idade, raça, cor, credo, orientação sexual e deficiência, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados em nossos processos.

We are a data and technology innovation hub and a Benefit Corporation working at the center of the federal government's mission to deliver for client stakeholders and the US public, looking for highly motivated contributors who thrive when trusted to own a hard problem and equipped to deliver the solution. Your first assignment Your first assignment is to own the database layer of a federal agency's enterprise data platform: the physical design, the models, and the performance that let analysts and systems trust it at scale. You will shape how a large, high-volume platform is structured and tuned across Amazon Aurora, DynamoDB, and Apache Iceberg tables on S3. The work is real, hard, and it matters. It is also where you start, not the shape of your career here: we hire people, not seats, and we move our best to where the hardest problems are. What You'll Build A database layer that performs: physical design (partitioning, indexing, and storage layout at scale), query and plan tuning on large datasets, and data models that hold up The pipes and guardrails around it: schema migrations, S3 load patterns into the relational and Iceberg stores, stored procedures, and Apache Ranger access controls In time, the firm itself: new capabilities, tools, and lines of business you help spin up Who you are You are the person who makes a database fast and keeps it honest, and you take that ownership seriously. You have designed and tuned large data platforms, and you know why the physical model matters. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. What You Bring Deep, hands-on ownership of a database layer on Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL-compatible), DynamoDB, and S3 with Apache Iceberg tables: physical design, tuning, and modeling The craft around it: stored procedures, schema migration, S3 load patterns into the platform stores, and governed access The judgment to build in a regulated environment where accuracy and auditability are not optional What you'll need Sole United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination are required for this initial engagement. This is a hybrid role based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and it requires commuting into DC regularly. Everything else, the years, the certifications, the specific tools, we ask in the application and get into during the interview. What We Offer A high-performing team of developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists solving complex, real-world problems, with work that runs from strategy formulation to hands-on implementation. We develop people across roles and clients, with extensive onboarding and sponsored training and professional development. And Peregrine has been a Benefit Corporation from day one: public value is built into the work itself, not bolted on afterward. Work worth your best years. What We Commit To As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this opening and future roles. Requirements 7+ years of database development and administration experience Bachelor's degree Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL-compatible), DynamoDB, and S3 with Apache Iceberg tables Physical design at scale: partitioning, indexing, and storage layout Query and EXPLAIN-plan tuning on large datasets Logical and physical data modeling PL/pgSQL stored procedures and S3 load patterns into the relational and Iceberg stores Basic proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel Preferred Schema migration tooling (AWS Schema Conversion Tool) Apache Ranger access controls Neptune or Neo4j Federal information technology or high-volume transaction experience Familiarity with AI-assisted developer tooling Benefits Medical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

We believe in providing an unmatched experience, every day and everywhere, driven by our people, processes, and technology. Copart is seeking a Senior Network Engineer based out of Las Vegas . In this role, you will help design, build, operate, and continuously improve Copart's global network infrastructure, supporting enterprise data centers, remote offices, and critical business services worldwide. As a senior member of the team, you will lead technical initiatives, influence engineering decisions, mentor fellow engineers, and drive operational excellence across our global network. Ideal Candidate Ownership – Takes ownership of the health of the environment, not just assigned tasks. Proactively identifies issues, follows through on commitments, and consistently looks for opportunities to improve systems, processes, and documentation. Believes in leaving the environment better than they found it. Engineering Mindset – Solves problems by understanding the "why," balancing technical excellence with operational practicality, and making decisions supported by data. Continuous Improvement – Constantly looks for opportunities to improve systems, processes, automation, and documentation, leaving things better than they found them. Collaborative – Shares knowledge, mentors others, communicates effectively, and recognizes that the best engineering outcomes come from strong teamwork. Curious – Continually expands technical knowledge beyond networking, embracing automation, AI-assisted engineering, and emerging technologies to solve increasingly complex problems. “ We hire engineers for their mindset, not just their résumé. Experience matters, but we place even greater value on ownership, technical judgment, curiosity, continuous improvement, and the ability to positively influence those around you.” Essential Duties And Responsibilities Own network projects from initial planning through implementation, validation, documentation, and operational handoff. Lead the technical design, optimization, and deployment of enterprise network infrastructure across global data centers and remote sites. Develop well-supported technical proposals by analyzing operational data, business requirements, performance metrics, and long-term scalability. Present recommendations with clear trade-offs, risks, and implementation strategies. Provide technical leadership on cross-functional initiatives, driving engineering decisions through collaboration, sound technical judgment, and data-driven analysis. Review engineering designs, implementation plans, and change requests to ensure alignment with network standards and operational best practices. Serve as a technical mentor to junior engineers by providing guidance, sharing knowledge, and promoting engineering excellence and accountability. Plan and lead network implementations, upgrades, migrations, and maintenance activities with minimal business impact. Deploy, scale, and continuously improve enterprise networking solutions across global offices and data centers. Support and optimize a global WAN environment consisting of Fortinet SD-WAN, Site-to-Site VPN, and point-to-point connectivity. Analyze application behavior, network performance, and capacity trends to recommend infrastructure improvements. Research, evaluate, and recommend technologies that improve network reliability, visibility, operational efficiency, and automation. Develop, maintain, and enforce network standards, engineering best practices, and operational procedures. Create and maintain technical documentation, network diagrams, troubleshooting guides, and standard operating procedures. Proactively monitor network health and resolve issues before they impact production services. Lead troubleshooting efforts during complex infrastructure and application incidents, driving root cause analysis and permanent corrective actions. Review, implement, and validate network changes in accordance with established Change Management (ITIL) processes. Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to understand business requirements and deliver scalable, reliable network solutions. Act as a backup engineer on peer-owned projects to ensure continuity, knowledge sharing, and successful project delivery. Participate in an on-call rotation supporting production infrastructure. Demonstrate excellent written and verbal communication skills while thriving in a collaborative engineering environment. Experience with network automation, AI-assisted operations, or agentic workflows is highly desirable. Provide periodic "smart hands" and physical support (e.g., server hardware swaps, cabling, component replacement) in collaboration with remote engineering and IT teams. Technical Qualifications Enterprise Networking Extensive experience designing, implementing, and troubleshooting enterprise network (L2/L3) infrastructure using Cisco enterprise platforms (Catalyst, Nexus). Experience implementing and supporting enterprise security in ANY of platforms (Fortinet, Cisco Firepower/ASA, Palo Alto, or equivalent). Core Technical Skills Enterprise routing and switching (OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, VRF, VLANs, STP) Layer 2 technologies (LACP/EtherChannel, VPC, Switch Stacking) Enterprise security (ACLs, NAT, VPNs, TACACS+, Cisco ISE or equivalent) High availability and resilient network design Enterprise data center networking Preferred Expectations Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills Experience leading technical projects or mentoring engineers Excellent communication and collaboration skills Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment Flexible to participate in on-call rotations and occasional off-hours work Preferred Qualifications (Experience In Any Of The Following) Linux/Unix Python, Ansible, APIs, or network automation AI-assisted engineering and agentic workflows Enterprise monitoring, observability, or configuration management tools A10 load balancers or comparable technologies Experience & Certifications CCNP/CCIE or equivalent experience is highly desirable. 7+ years of working experience in the Networking Engineering Field. (While 7+ years of networking experience is generally expected for this role, we place greater value on engineering mindset, ownership, technical curiosity, sound judgment, and the ability to make meaningful contributions than on years of experience alone.) Benefits Summary Medical/Dental/Vision 401k plus a company match ESPP - Employee Stock Purchase Plan EAP - Employee Assistance Program (no cost to you) Vacation & Sick pay Paid Company Holidays Life and AD&D Insurance Discounts Along With Many Other Employee Benefits. You will lead Azure architecture decisions, automate infrastructure, strengthen cloud governance, and collaborate with engineering and security teams to modernize critical technology platforms. We know that you can’t have great technology services without amazing people. At MetroStar, we are obsessed with our people and have led a two-decade legacy of building the best and brightest teams. Because we know our future relies on our deep understanding and relentless focus on our people, we live by our mission: A passion for our people. Value for our customers. If you think you can see yourself delivering our mission and pursuing our goals with us, then check out the job description below! What you’ll do: Cloud Infrastructure Management: Design, implement, and maintain Azure cloud infrastructure using Azure Virtual Machines (VMs), Virtual Networks (VNets), Azure SQL Database, Blob Storage, Managed Disks, and Azure Active Directory (AAD). Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Automate Azure resource provisioning and configuration using Terraform, Azure Resource Manager (ARM) templates, and Ansible. Security & Compliance: Implement Azure cloud security best practices, including role-based access control (RBAC), Azure DDoS Protection, Microsoft Defender for Cloud, encryption at rest/in transit, and alignment with FedRAMP, NIST, and DoD compliance standards. CI/CD Pipeline Management: Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines using GitLab, Jenkins, and Azure DevOps Pipelines to streamline deployments and improve delivery velocity. Monitoring & Optimization: Utilize Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, Azure Application Insights, and Azure Activity Logs to track system health, troubleshoot issues, and enhance performance. Networking & Load Balancing: Configure and optimize Azure Virtual Networks (VNets), Azure DNS, Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, and ExpressRoute for secure and scalable connectivity. Hybrid Cloud & Migration: Support Azure cloud migrations and hybrid environments, integrating with on-premises infrastructure using Azure Arc, Azure Migrate, and Azure Site Recovery.Automation & Scripting: Develop automation scripts using Python, PowerShell, and Bash to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual workloads. Disaster Recovery & Backup Solutions: Implement Azure backup strategies, including Azure Backup, blob lifecycle management, and snapshot automation. Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with client organizations, DevOps teams, and security engineers to align Azure-based solutions with organizational objectives and compliance requirements. What you’ll need to succeed: Active Secret security clearance. Azure Solutions Architect certification (preferred) or equivalent Azure certification. 10+ years of experience in cloud engineering, DevOps, or systems administration, with a strong focus on Microsoft Azure environments. 5+ years of experience with Azure Cloud Engineering, IaC (Terraform), GiLab, and CI/CD pipelines. 4+ years of experience with PowerShell scripting. Hands-on experience with Ansible, Jenkins, GitHub, and Azure DevOps services. Experience working in multi-cloud and hybrid environments integrating Azure and on-premise infrastructure. Strong proficiency in Azure networking services (e.g., Virtual Networks, Azure DNS, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, or Azure Load Balancer/Application Gateway). Strong knowledge of Azure Active Directory (AAD), encryption, security monitoring, and compliance frameworks (e.g., FedRAMP, NIST, and applicable security standards). Proficiency in Python, PowerShell, Bash, and YAML/JSON for cloud automation and system management. The Systems Reconfiguration Engineer serves as CACI's Systems/Software Engineering - IT professional responsible for analyzing operational requirements, modifying system configurations, integrating hardware and software components, and ensuring systems can be rapidly adapted to changing mission, site, network, and operational conditions. Reporting to the Systems Engineering Lead, this position provides senior technical expertise supporting distributed, expeditionary, and contested logistics environments. The Systems Reconfiguration Engineer works closely with Government stakeholders, systems engineers, software engineers, network engineers, cybersecurity personnel, field service engineers, data engineers, logistics personnel, vendors, and mission partners to plan and execute system reconfiguration activities while maintaining interoperability, cybersecurity, configuration control, and operational availability. The position supports Joint Theater Distribution Centers (JTDCs), Intermediate Staging Bases (ISBs), command-and-control nodes, warehouses, expeditionary facilities, and forward operating locations and provides technical guidance to junior engineering and technical personnel. Responsibilities Plan, engineer, execute, and validate reconfiguration of mission-critical IT, logistics, communications, and supporting systems in response to operational, site, network, and mission changes. Analyze system architectures, technical baselines, interfaces, dependencies, and operational requirements to determine reconfiguration approaches that minimize mission disruption. Modify and validate hardware, software, operating system, application, network, interface, and device configurations within approved technical and security baselines. Develop system reconfiguration plans, implementation procedures, rollback plans, test procedures, engineering change documentation, and technical risk assessments. Coordinate with systems, software, network, cybersecurity, data, field service, and logistics personnel to integrate reconfigured capabilities into operational environments. Perform integration, functional, interoperability, regression, and operational acceptance testing following system reconfiguration or technology insertion. Support rapid reconfiguration and relocation of systems supporting JTDCs, ISBs, warehouses, command-and-control nodes, expeditionary facilities, and forward operating locations. Maintain configuration baselines, system inventories, interface control documentation, engineering drawings, technical data, version records, and change histories. Support configuration control boards, engineering reviews, technical interchange meetings, and change-management processes; assess proposed changes for technical and operational impact. Coordinate system reconfiguration activities with RMF, cybersecurity, vulnerability management, and information assurance personnel to preserve authorization and security compliance. Support integration of edge devices, sensors, RFID/NFC technologies, data collection platforms, communications equipment, and enterprise applications into reconfigured system architectures. Evaluate system performance following reconfiguration and develop technical recommendations to improve availability, resilience, interoperability, scalability, and maintainability. Support disconnected, disrupted, intermittent, and limited-bandwidth (DDIL) environments by developing configurations that sustain essential capabilities during degraded communications. Provide senior technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, technicians, and field personnel performing configuration, integration, installation, and troubleshooting activities. Develop and maintain technical SOPs, configuration guides, installation procedures, test records, lessons learned, and knowledge-management products. Support exercises, contingency operations, humanitarian assistance/disaster response, surge requirements, and emergent missions requiring rapid system adaptation or deployment. Coordinate with Government technical authorities, vendors, OEMs, and mission partners to resolve complex engineering issues and implement approved system changes. Ensure engineering and reconfiguration activities comply with applicable DoD cybersecurity, configuration management, interoperability, technical, safety, and contractual requirements. Identify and recommend engineering improvements, automation opportunities, and reconfiguration strategies that increase system resilience and reduce restoration or deployment timelines. Qualifications Required: Minimum 8 years of experience supporting systems engineering, systems integration, software or IT engineering, system configuration, field engineering, or related Government or Department of Defense technical operations. Experience configuring, integrating, testing, troubleshooting, and sustaining complex hardware/software systems in enterprise, tactical, expeditionary, or distributed environments. Experience developing technical implementation plans, configuration documentation, test procedures, engineering change packages, or system baseline documentation. Experience troubleshooting complex system, application, interface, network, or interoperability issues and coordinating technical resolution across multiple engineering disciplines. Demonstrated ability to support configuration management, change control, cybersecurity compliance, and operational testing while maintaining mission availability. Working knowledge of systems engineering principles, configuration management, system lifecycle management, virtualization, networking, cybersecurity, and DoD IT environments. Active Secret Clearance Desired Bachelor's Degree in Systems Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. Experience supporting Department of Defense, Joint, Combatant Command, Service Component, USSOCOM, SOCPAC, or other geographically dispersed Government technical operations. Experience with Windows and Linux environments, virtualization platforms, cloud or hybrid architectures, APIs, databases, networking technologies, edge computing, or containerized applications. Experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, VMware, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, PowerShell, Python, Git, Jira, ServiceNow, or comparable engineering and configuration-management tools. Knowledge of DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF), DISA STIGs, NIST security controls, configuration management practices, and system authorization requirements. A focus on continuous growth. new_matches.title: Lead Cloud Platform / DevSecOps Engineer
new_matches.description: POSITION DESCRIPTION: The Lead Cloud Platform / DevSecOps Engineer is a senior technical leader responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and maintaining cloud infrastructure and delivery pipelines in Microsoft Azure, with a primary focus on Azure Government environments. This role is intended to fill a critical gap in Azure platform expertise and will serve as a key resource in establishing and sustaining secure, scalable, and compliant cloud foundations for federal systems. The ideal candidate brings broad, hands-on Azure experience, including Azure Landing Zones, preferably Mission Landing Zone, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), and infrastructure deployed in Azure Government with an understanding of IL4/IL5 compliance considerations. This individual will lead the ongoing maintenance and improvement of infrastructure-as-code, cloud configuration, deployment automation, and CI/CD pipelines, while integrating code scanning and automated testing throughout the delivery lifecycle. This role works closely with software engineers, architects, cybersecurity stakeholders, and program leadership to ensure cloud environments are reliable, compliant, and built for operational success in regulated government environments. The successful candidate will combine strong technical depth with sound engineering judgment and the ability to establish repeatable, secure cloud delivery practices across teams. U.S. Citizenship and an active Secret clearance are required. This is a hybrid, full-time position with an onsite requirement of three days per week at our Crystal City headquarters. Key Responsibilities: Azure Cloud Architecture & Platform Engineering  Design, implement, and maintain Azure cloud environments, with strong emphasis on Azure Government. Support and evolve Azure Landing Zone architectures, preferably Mission Landing Zone. Build, configure, and manage Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) environments and supporting Azure services. Ensure cloud environments are secure, scalable, supportable, and aligned with mission and compliance requirements. Infrastructure as Code & Deployment Automation  Develop, maintain, and enhance Infrastructure as Code using Bicep. Manage cloud configuration, environment provisioning, and deployment automation across development, test, and production environments. Standardize infrastructure deployments to improve consistency, security, and maintainability. Support release engineering practices that enable reliable and repeatable application and infrastructure delivery. CI/CD, Security Integration & Quality Engineering  Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines supporting infrastructure and application delivery. Integrate code scanning, dependency scanning, and automated testing into CI/CD workflows. Strengthen DevSecOps practices by embedding security and quality controls throughout the software delivery lifecycle. Improve deployment reliability, traceability, and governance through automation and policy-driven processes. Compliance, Security & Operational Excellence  Engineer and maintain solutions with a compliance-focused mindset appropriate for Azure Government and IL4/IL5 environments. Partner with engineering and security teams to implement secure configurations, logging, monitoring, and access controls. Support audit readiness by ensuring infrastructure, deployments, and pipeline activities are well-documented, reproducible, and aligned with required controls. Contribute to platform hardening, cloud governance, and operational best practices. Collaboration & Technical Leadership  Serve as a subject matter expert in Azure platform engineering and DevSecOps practices. Collaborate with developers, architects, and program leadership to define and implement cloud platform standards. Mentor team members on Azure infrastructure, automation, deployment pipelines, and secure cloud delivery practices. Help drive engineering consistency and maturity across cloud-hosted environments. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE: 7+ years of experience in cloud engineering, platform engineering, DevSecOps, or closely related technical roles. Broad, hands-on experience working across Microsoft Azure services and cloud platform operations. Direct experience with Azure Landing Zones; Mission Landing Zone experience preferred. Strong experience with Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). Experience deploying and managing solutions in Azure Government. Understanding of cloud engineering and security requirements associated with IL4/IL5 environments. Strong experience maintaining Infrastructure as Code using Bicep. Experience managing cloud configuration, deployments, and CI/CD pipelines. Experience integrating code scanning and automated testing into CI/CD workflows. Strong understanding of Azure networking fundamentals, including Network Security Groups, route tables, and hub-and-spoke architectures. IAT Level II certification required. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. U.S. Citizenship and active Secret clearance required. DESIRED EXPERIENCE: IAT Level III certification. Experience with Mission Landing Zone implementations. Experience with Azure Log Analytics and cloud observability practices. Experience with Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server. Experience supporting containerized platforms and associated tooling in Azure. Experience managing AWS GovCloud environments. Familiarity with security tooling, policy enforcement, and compliance automation in regulated cloud environments. Experience supporting federal or DoD cloud modernization efforts. WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE OFFER: In addition to competitive salaries and opportunities for professional development and advancement, our employees enjoy a comprehensive range of benefits. To keep pace with the changing needs of our employees, we continually evaluate benefit plans. Paid time off 10 paid holidays Medical insurance Dental insurance Vision insurance Legal assistance Company-paid life insurance and AD&D Company-paid long term and short-term disability insurance Tuition reimbursement 401(k) plan with company contribution Continuing Education Opportunities

new_matches.title: Senior SSO Operations Engineer | Ping Identity
new_matches.description: Sabemos que carreiras podem ser tão diferentes quanto as próprias pessoas. Por isso, na EY, você terá a liberdade, as ferramentas e as condições para se desenvolver e construir uma carreira tão única quanto você. Em Tech Financial Services (Tech FSO) , estamos construindo um mundo de negócios melhor apoiando as necessidades e desafios tecnológicos dos nossos clientes do segmento financeiro, incluindo Mercado de Capitais, Bancos, Fintechs, Seguros e Gestão de Ativos. Entregamos soluções sob medida de acordo com as necessidades específicas de cada negócio, por meio de uma equipe multidisciplinar de especialistas em engenharia, identidade e acessos, segurança da informação, dados, desenvolvimento, UX e análise de negócios. #TechEY #TechFSO Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito? Como Senior SSO Operations Engineer , você atuará em um projeto internacional nearshore para um importante cliente do setor financeiro, prestando suporte operacional e de engenharia às plataformas corporativas de Single Sign-On e Identity and Access Management. Sua atuação estará concentrada na sustentação de ambientes produtivos, no onboarding de aplicações, no gerenciamento de incidentes e solicitações e no troubleshooting de integrações e fluxos de autenticação. Você também contribuirá para a disponibilidade, estabilidade, segurança e performance dos serviços de identidade e acesso. Por que você? Se você possui os requisitos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua: Graduação em Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados ou área relacionada; Inglês avançado (B2 ou superior), com capacidade de comunicação em ambiente internacional; Experiência profissional equivalente em tecnologias de identidade e autenticação também poderá ser considerada; Experiência prática em Identity and Access Management, Single Sign-On, federação de identidades e plataformas corporativas de autenticação; Experiência com administração e sustentação de PingFederate ou de outras plataformas enterprise de IAM e SSO; Conhecimento sólido dos protocolos SAML, OAuth 2.0 e OpenID Connect; Conhecimento de conceitos e processos relacionados a autenticação, autorização, federação de identidades e gestão de acessos; Experiência com onboarding de aplicações e manutenção de integrações SSO em ambientes corporativos; Experiência em troubleshooting de falhas de autenticação, autorização, federação e integrações de aplicações; Vivência no suporte a ambientes produtivos e plataformas de autenticação críticas para o negócio; Conhecimento de processos de Incident Management, Incident Response, Request Management e Production Support; Experiência com análise de logs e utilização de ferramentas de monitoramento ou observabilidade; Capacidade para administrar filas de incidentes e solicitações, realizar alterações de configuração e escalar problemas complexos quando necessário; Autonomia, capacidade analítica, organização e facilidade para colaborar com equipes de aplicações, infraestrutura, segurança e engenharia. Serão considerados diferenciais: Experiência prática com PingAccess e PingOne; Experiência com Splunk para análise de logs, monitoramento e investigação de incidentes; Conhecimento de Multi-Factor Authentication e troubleshooting de fluxos de MFA; Experiência com outras plataformas de identidade, como CA SiteMinder, Okta, ForgeRock, Microsoft Entra ID, SailPoint ou CyberArk; Conhecimento de ferramentas e processos de monitoramento da saúde operacional de plataformas; Certificações relacionadas a Ping Identity, IAM, segurança da informação ou tecnologias cloud. Principais responsabilidades: Prestar suporte operacional e de engenharia às plataformas corporativas de Single Sign-On e Identity and Access Management. Administrar, configurar e sustentar ambientes Ping Identity, com foco em PingFederate e, quando aplicável, PingAccess e PingOne. Garantir a estabilidade, disponibilidade, segurança e performance dos serviços de autenticação e controle de acesso. Implementar, manter e atualizar configurações de aplicações integradas ao ambiente SSO. Realizar o onboarding de novas aplicações utilizando padrões e protocolos como SAML, OAuth 2.0 e OpenID Connect. Executar alterações de configuração relacionadas a autenticação, autorização, federação de identidades e políticas de acesso. Investigar e solucionar falhas em fluxos de autenticação, integrações SSO e serviços de Identity and Access Management. Realizar análise de logs utilizando Splunk ou ferramentas equivalentes para diagnosticar incidentes e identificar oportunidades de melhoria. Participar de investigações e respostas a incidentes, contribuindo para a análise de causa raiz e implementação de ações corretivas. Executar health checks e monitorar a disponibilidade, performance e integridade operacional das plataformas de identidade. Administrar filas de solicitações e incidentes, garantindo registro, priorização, acompanhamento, comunicação e resolução adequados. Realizar escalonamentos técnicos e colaborar com engenheiros e especialistas na resolução de problemas de maior complexidade. Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de aplicações, infraestrutura, segurança e operações para garantir serviços confiáveis de autenticação e acesso. Manter procedimentos técnicos, documentação operacional e bases de conhecimento atualizados. Contribuir para iniciativas de automação, padronização e melhoria contínua dos serviços de identidade e gestão de acessos. Conheça alguns de nossos benefícios: Assistência médica e odontológica, Auxílio creche, Plataforma de benefícios e descontos exclusivos EY, Incentivos à educação, Day off de aniversário, Gympass/Wellhub, Participação nos Lucros (PLR), Previdência privada, Vale Alimentação e / ou Vale Alimentação e Transporte, e muito mais. O que oferecemos: Na EY, você se desenvolve com habilidades voltadas para o futuro e se abastece de experiências de classe mundial. Nós capacitaremos você em um ambiente flexível e potencializaremos seus talentos extraordinários em uma cultura diversa e inclusiva, com equipes globalmente conectadas. Pelo 4o ano consecutivo, a EY está na lista do Great Place to Work como uma das melhores empresa para se trabalhar, com destaque para as categorias de diversidade. Você poderá fazer parte de nossos programas e grupos que, juntos a inúmeras iniciativas internas, apoiam nossa constante busca pela equidade. Você gostaria de moldar seu futuro com confiança? Inscreva-se hoje! Para ajudar a criar a melhor experiência durante o processo de recrutamento, por favor, descreva qualquer acessibilidade você possa precisar. Quer se sentir desafiado/a, motivado/a e valorizado/a todos os dias? Inspirar mudanças e deixar um legado? Faça parte do nosso time e ajude-nos na construção de um mundo de negócios melhor! Saiba mais sobre como é trabalhar na EY: Carreiras na EY LinkedIn @EY Instagram @eybrasilcarreiras Oportunidade disponível em modelo presencial (com flexibilidade para o remoto) nos escritórios da EY em todo o Brasil. A EY acredita na igualdade de oportunidades. Independentemente de gênero, idade, raça, cor, credo, orientação sexual e deficiência, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados em nossos processos.
